{{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Eagleeye.png |location =[[Woods]] |given by =[[Prapor]] |reward = |reputation = |quest number = |previous =[[Debut]] |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Hey there, warrior! One of my squads has been radio silent for a while now. When all this mess started, I sent them out near the Priozersk forest to move an important shipment. I'm afraid they got hit: last time we managed to get through, they reported USECs closing in on them from the hills. Go check it out, see if anyone's still alive. The convoy definitely had a BRDM car, a Bukhanka, and some truck, can't remember which one. Chances are the USECs have dug in somewhere nearby, so keep your head on a swivel. Oh, and so you don't get yourself lost among the scary square kilometer of trees, I'm issuing you a compass. Dismissed.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 5 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate Prapor's missing convoy on [[Woods]] * Locate the temporary USEC camp on [[Woods]] ==Rewards== * +3,000 [[EXP]] * [[Prapor]] Rep '''+0.1''' * 80,000 Roubles ** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{Quote|So my boys never made it and the convoy's been picked clean... Plus the USECs have a position nearby, you say? Alright, you did your part. Here's your reward.}} ==Initial Equipment== {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount |- |[[File:Compass icon.png|link=EYE MK.2 professional hand-held compass]] |[[EYE MK.2 professional hand-held compass]] |1 |} ==Guide== In this quest you have to locate [[Prapor]]'s missing convoy and the USEC camp on [[Woods]]. ====Convoy location==== The convoy is located in the north, on the road between the lakes that leads to the "Scav Bunker" extraction. Make sure to get close to the vehicles for the objective to trigger.
